=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line or code reference: The jq filter computing `requests` in the fixup-adoption path — `($lines[0] | capture("^<!-- ai:unblock-fixup-request:v1 ...")) as $m` followed by `{item: $m.item, id: $m.id, ...}`
  severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The jq expression iterates every comment by the pipeline login on the tracking issue, including non-fixup comments; `capture` returns null for those comments and `$m.item` fails with "Cannot index null", causing the invocation to fall back to an empty `requests` array.
  WHY: Every fix-up request on a tracking issue that already has a pipeline-authored comment is silently dropped, so no issue is created, no wait-marker is posted, and the wave never advances.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh
  Line or code reference: The jq expression computing the newest wait marker — `($last | capture("^<!-- ai:unblock-wait:v1 item=...")) as $m | select($m.item == $item)`
  severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: For comments whose last non-empty line is not a wait marker, `capture` returns null and `$m.item` fails with "Cannot index null"; the error is masked and `wait` stays empty.
  WHY: The judge misreads an active fix-up wait as absent and proceeds to re-judge the item instead of waiting for its fix-up to merge.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh
  Line or code reference: jq binding expression — `any((.issue_number_map // {})[]; . == $issue) or any(.waves[]?.issues[]?; .github_issue == $issue) or any(.security_pass_active_fix_issues[]?; . == $issue)`
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The project-binding check omits `validation_active_fix_issues` from the or-chain.
  WHY: A blocked validation fix-up issue is absent from the checked fields, so binding verification fails, no marker is posted, and `run_unblock_scan` can redispatch the judge indefinitely.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py
  Line or code reference: The `auto_answer` branch at the `elif name == "auto_answer":` block — the phase-label swap `remove_label ai:needs-human` + `add_labels ai:clarification` only fires when `ctx["stop"] == "needs-human"`.
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: For `clarify-respond-failed` or `plan-failed`, the verdict posts `/answer` without changing the issue's labels.
  WHY: `plan.yml` accepts `/answer` only for issues labeled `ai:planning`, `ai:clarification`, or `ai:blocked`; the answer is skipped and the issue remains blocked.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh
  Line or code reference: jq expression computing `missing_project_markers` — `.body | split("\n") | map(select(length > 0)) | last` followed by `select(startswith("<!-- ai:unblock:v1 item=" + $item + " ") and endswith(" -->"))`
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If a pipeline-authored comment has an empty or whitespace-only body, `last` evaluates to null and `startswith` is called on null.
  WHY: The jq command fails with a type error, logs `reason=project_ledger_unreadable`, and aborts judge execution before it reaches a decision.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line or code reference: The activation-verify job uses concurrency group `operator-step-writer-${{ github.repository }}`, and the unblock judge job (`unblock_judge.yml`) also uses the same concurrency group. But `run_project_activation_verify` runs inside the poller job under concurrency group `orchestrate-poll-${{ github.repository }}`.

  WHY: A project-completion activation verify can race with a PR-merge activation verify or unblock-judge write, overwriting newly added operator-step sections.
